LUT-Adapt & Mixture-of-Limits [T/E · measured_j / reported_j]

Jetson Thor TI INA3221 shunts (measured_j) recorded 162.56-162.71 nJ/op (87x CpJ vs INT8 MLP) on bit-sliced 80-LUT6 tables; on workstation reported_j, MoL + Qwen3.6-35B solved 44/48 (91.67%) coding tasks.

1/2 Named arms & substrate separation:
- Thor INA3221 measured_j: 87x LUT6 CpJ & 222.57x 56-bit wearable gate
- Workstation reported_j: 44/48 (LA-17, Qwen3.6-35B + <think>) & 10/16 hard adversarial (LA-21, 24B+120B; 6/16 unsolved)
- Cortex-M55 cycles & FPGA VCD est_j separated

2/2 Cold vs warm & open limits:
- LUT6 crystals compress recurring low-entropy skills (Wave 2/3); novel Olympiad items scored 0/16 (abstained)
- Gated cais/hle HTTP 403 respected without bypass (32 open SuperGPQA/MathArena items used)
- M.2 XC7A200T 0.86 est_W awaits rail shunts
